sections.contract: Native score, criteria, per-task three attempts, median/range, domain and overall score.
sections.interpretation: Native score is not a universal binary completion rate.

sections.contract: Tool existence, arguments and JSON-schema validity with coverage.
sections.interpretation: Schema acceptance does not establish semantic correctness.

sections.contract: Structured success/errors, exact repeated signatures, recovery and retries.
sections.interpretation: Probes and repeated calls may be legitimate. Exact retry purpose is not universally identified.

sections.contract: Correct tool, arguments, target and resulting action.
sections.interpretation: Reuse native criteria; no universal per-call semantic denominator was captured.

sections.contract: Artifact integrity, factual correctness, unauthorized actions, injection safety, false completion.
sections.interpretation: Native rubric criteria retained; universal false-completion claims were not reviewed.

sections.contract: Request to headers, first text, first tool action, full response; p50/p95.
sections.interpretation: First text is absent for tool-only responses. Missing events remain unknown.

sections.contract: Assistant-event spacing and inference-start spacing where native timestamps exist.
sections.interpretation: Includes tools/thinking. These are not comparable pure model-turn delays; Hermes lacks request-start wall timestamps.

sections.contract: Agent execution, trial wall, setup, grading and pre-environment waiting.
sections.interpretation: Pre-environment wait is not a separately instrumented scheduler-only queue delay.

sections.contract: Input, output, cached input, reasoning output; candidate, images and judging separately.
sections.interpretation: Failed or open requests may omit usage; observed sums are lower bounds.

sections.contract: Started, recorded, completed and unclosed calls; failures, image/auxiliary calls and recovery judging.
sections.interpretation: Delegated/compaction requests are included when observed but are not all independently labeled.

sections.contract: Output tokens / total completed-response duration, p50/p95 and coverage.
sections.interpretation: Includes reasoning and request wait. Isolated decode tokens/sec was not recorded.

sections.contract: Peak memory/disk and container cleanup status.
sections.interpretation: Resource limits and owner cleanup receipts are available; historical per-container peaks were not captured.

sections.contract: Task attempt median/range; stratified task bootstrap intervals.
sections.interpretation: Intervals describe resampling selected tasks, not official-population representativeness.

sections.contract: Speed, tokens and inference volume on tasks every agent completes.
sections.interpretation: All nine attempts must score 100% and finish without a runtime exception; avoids ranking quick failures as efficient.

conditions.fast_policy: Owner approved documented Fast configuration; record returned tiers separately without claiming confirmed served Fast.
conditions.cleanup: Export and grade before deleting each container. Retire task fixtures/images after all nine attempts; shared suite image stays while remaining tasks need it.

observability_adaptations.purpose: Preserve every file inspected by the native workspace grader for post-cleanup verification. Task identities, prompts, rubrics and budgets unchanged.

limitations: Same requested model/effort/priority and subscription route were verified. Actual returned tiers remain recorded; requested priority does not prove served Fast.
Native agent tools and default prompts differ by design. Native judge sampling and live web availability can vary.
Schema validity and task scores do not establish semantic correctness of every individual tool call.
32 selected tasks: three per domain except Memory, which has two; equal domain weighting.
Native task budgets are retained. Timed-out attempts can earn partial or full credit from eligible saved work.
Schema validity is not semantic tool accuracy. Structured tool-result coverage differs by native export.
Unreported token usage and unclosed requests remain unknown; observed totals may be lower bounds.
Between-event spacing and response throughput include tools, reasoning and waiting; isolated model decoding speed is unknown.
Historical peak memory/disk were not measured. Limits and cleanup provenance are recorded.
Original, superseded and abandoned grading requests are retained separately from candidate usage.
Large generated artifacts, private reasoning, credentials, owner paths and embedded payloads are omitted from the public package.

bootstrap.method: Paired task resampling within each domain, preserving three-attempt means and equal domain weights; conditional on selected tasks.

leon: 1. Save a minimum complete deliverable early
31 of 96 attempts hit native deadlines. All three Meeting Index and all three Council Votes attempts lacked the required report at 180 seconds. Checkpoint a usable file before further analysis.
2. Verify analysis outputs against required fields
Syslog averaged 34.53% and HDFS 48.50%. Inspect native criteria and complete the requested report before optional follow-up work.
Native Blog and Workflow judge notes identify unrelated weather calls, duplicate discovery and setup commentary. Prefer task-relevant tools and avoid consuming short native budgets on unrelated work.
hermes: 1. Finish meeting deliverables within the budget
Meeting Index scored zero in all three attempts; Council Votes mostly lacked the requested report. Extract the required fields and write a first report before expanding analysis or delegation.
Apache Error Analysis averaged 35.00%, with large attempt variability and deadline outcomes. Persist the required report and verify its counted errors early.
Finance Report averaged 63.75%. Use the native criterion breakdown to verify all requested calculations and report sections; avoid treating successful tool execution as complete task accuracy.
openclaw: 1. Deliver a report before research expires

All three IT Procurement attempts scored zero at the native five-minute deadline. All Meeting Index and Council Votes attempts also lacked their requested reports. Save an evidence-backed partial deliverable before further searching.
Humanizer averaged 65.42%, below its other writing tasks. Verify the task's requested style and content against the native rubric before finalizing.

Blog and Workflow judge notes identify unnecessary repository inspection and commit attempts, including recovery from missing Git identity. Keep the native workflow focused on the requested deliverables.
